Class PreOrderAcceptEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
de.eldoria.companies.events.order.OrderEvent<IFullOrder>
de.eldoria.companies.events.order.PreOrderAcceptEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
CancellableWithReason, CompanyProvider<ICompanyProfile>, OrderProvider<IFullOrder>, OwnerProvider, PlayerProvider<org.bukkit.entity.Player>, org.bukkit.event.Cancellable
public class PreOrderAcceptEvent extends OrderEvent<IFullOrder> implements CompanyProvider<ICompanyProfile>, PlayerProvider<org.bukkit.entity.Player>, CancellableWithReason
A member of a company is about to accept an order for the company.

Fired before the order is claimed, usually off the main thread; the event may be asynchronous. Cancelling it leaves the order unclaimed and shows the reason to the member. It fires only on the server where the member accepts the order.

Orders are anonymous: never show the owner of the order to the member. OrderAcceptEvent follows once the order is claimed.
